title: Zurvival Mod
description: Zurvival Mod - A mod that adds things from Zurvival.
body:
Zurvival Mod - A mod that adds things from Zurvival.

**Added:**
- Zombie from Zurvival
- Gun (also from zurvival)
- ZCoin - currency from the game
- Bullets (for a gun)
- New trades with the traveling merchant
- Secret item (from the game logo)
